verdict: No paid ads ran this period; organic traffic is the only source and softening.
narrative: No spend ran on Meta or Google Ads at any point in the last 28 days, so every visitor and profile action came entirely from your Google Business Profile and organic search. Your profile generated 52 actions this period — 36 direction requests and 16 website clicks — but activity dropped 35% in the most recent 7 days compared to the 7 days before, with the last three days showing zero profile actions. Website sessions followed the same soft downward drift, down about 4% week over week. Paid campaigns are being reactivated to restore lead flow and take pressure off organic as the sole traffic source; once live, you should see leads and cost-per-lead data return in next week's report.
